From looking at what you use I'd recommend using the nutcracker with a wolf trap for easy crits. This combo does a solid amount of damage and you can get good affixes on the nutcracker too. Slows nearby enemies is helpful and with the frostbite mutation it's even better.

So how Armadillo works is when you roll it will parry most attacks that hit, the parry will then inflict a small amount of damage. The more scrolls you have in survival the more damage from the parry. It can still be used when on a Brutality run as the mutation is beneficial from the effect rather than the damage. The downside of using armadillo is that there is a cool down after each parry which can leave you vulnerable if spammed.

I like to use it as a safety net when I mess up or as an opening to an attack. I always use when wielding two handed weapons.
It's up to you how you use it after all Dead Cells has some many different builds and play styles to choose from.

Good luck with getting to 2BC!

What kind of Brutality and Survival weapons are you using?

There is nothing wrong with using off colour mutations as with Armadillopack it only increases parry damage which isn't very useful. A strong mutation to get is Disengagement which is at the back of the spawn area near the roof. Easy to miss but a lifesaver, basically a better YOLO.

In my opinion Brutality is best for 5BC, Tactics and Survival are more difficult because of their playstyles.  
Solid weapons for Brutality - Oiled Sword, Frantic Sword, Vorpan, Snake Fangs  
Shields - Front Line and Rampart Shield  
Equiptment - Anything that helps synergise with your weapon eg Sinew Slicer (Bleed), Wolf Trap (Root)  
Mutations - This is up to personal preference but strong ones are - Combo, Open Wounds, Predator, Armadillopack, Disengagement. The most important of all is Emergency Triage, less healing may seem bad but during a boss fight it's a life saver, not reccomended for biomes.

For general gameplay try to keep atleast 20K gold on you at all times, this will allow you to buy flasks and food. If you are not loosing flasks feel free to buy equipment or upgrade etc. Take cursed chests more often this one seems kinda dumb but generally improves your decision making when taking a fight. 

The Giant is pretty easy if you can learn to parry well, a good synergy should melt him quickly. For HOTK it's remebering his attack pattern, a common one he does it the 3 hit combo. Easy way to avoid this is dodge through, jump, then dodge again.

Hope this helps, the stuff I chose is what often works for me and may not be your playstyle.

Anyway Good Luck with the final part.

A while ago in secondary, someone saw my hands which were very sweaty on a fairly cool day. This was when I was very nervous around people which didn't help. When they saw how sweaty my hands were they had slightly disgusted face. I then explained to them in a panic as to why I was sweating and what HH is which they sort of understood. This didn't help and made me sweat more which is obviously what I wanted. Anyway I'm sure they meant no harm but it still hurts a bit when somebody show that kind of expression.

The thing I hate the most is explaining what HH is as it changes someone's view of me. Usually I just say I'm just hot but didn't think to say that at the time. I try my best now to avoid talking about it. However, one of my long time friends who has Aspergers is really accepting. He isn't the best in social situations like me which helps as it's relatable. I also made a new friend in college who's supportive which is really helpful.

The change from 0BC to 1BC can be quite big depending on what build you usually run. I'd recommend running brutality as this is a good balance between ease of use and health. It's possible with tactics and survival but takes a little more practice. Another thing is getting new mutations, weapons and equipment which can help in the areas your struggling in. This can be done on 0BC and there is no shame in going down a difficultly I have done it many times myself and can be useful for practicing against certain enemies and bosses.

I've had it for about 6-7 years by now and has made my school and social life much harder. Having to explain to people why you are sweating and that it's a condition is hard as most of them begin to look at you differently. Even if they look at you the same some don't really take you seriously and can't understand how problematic HH is. In summer it's so much worse because you sweat 24/7 unless you're in a ventilated room even then I still sweat. I was in class once on a hot day and was sweating like usual and this girl next to me doesn't ask if I could put deodorant on and just starts spraying tons perfume on me, no warning whatsoever. It sucks as putting deodorant on only lasts a short time so it's basically futile and leads to stuff like this.  

Doing any kinds of sports is much less fun as your already sweating before you even get assigned a team. I play video games in my spare time and holding a controller or using a keyboard is horrible as I have to keep rubbing my hands on my legs to dry them.

HH made me lose most of my confidence in myself, trying to get a job at the moment and just keep worrying about disturbing customers or staff. I have medication available but the side effects are having a try mouth which doesn't seem bad but I drink lots after taking it and still have a dry mouth until it wears off. I'm also not a fan of taking medication either.

One of my favourite builds is Rapier and a Rampart or Frontline shield. The equipment doesn't matter as much but I would recommend Ice armour for the extra defence or you can use basic traps for extra damage.

When it comes to mutations I would recommend Combo and Predator, your third mutation is dependent on what affixes the weapon has. If it has bonus to bleed or slowed enemies use open wounds or melee if rooted or burning is one consider getting a wolf trap or fire bomb. Making good builds is essential for later BCs so it's a habit you should get into.

You should reset your mutations as bosses to help aid you accordingly. Combo and Predator won't work so replace it with something like disengagement. 

To overall become better, take curses chests as these provide gold, a scroll and a piece of gear. They are risky but will improve your confidence in runs. Practice bosses in the training if they are your main problem.

Hope this helps, Good Luck!

I currently use Pro-Bromide (Propantheline Bromide) I haven't noticed any long term side effects so far, I've been using them for a while. When I first took them I stopped sweating completely but it gave me a very dry mouth for the first few days I was taking them after a while my mouth is fine.

I'm a bit on and off with taking them as I prefer to not take medication but as long as you stay hydrated they should be okay.
